name: sqlite-derived-projection
description: SQLitePlotIndex schema mirrors plotToIndexRow exactly (id, name, status, created_at, updated_at) and never stores intent or attachment content. Enforces SPEC §5.4 by construction — a column with no projection function in plot-index.ts can't exist. Index is rebuilt purely from .plot/pl-*.json files; rebuild() wipes and refills inside a single transaction so partial reindexes can't leave half-written state.

content: SQLite WAL mode (PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL) writes sibling .index.db-wal and .index.db-shm files. Code or tests that wipe the DB on disk must rm all three; otherwise the next Database open recovers from a stale WAL and the schema/data come back in an unexpected state. Affects plot rebuild-index and integration tests in plot/src/sqlite-index.test.ts.
